manual_review_reason: WNYO's official Submissions page says it is currently accepting defined music categories and publishes genre-specific email routes. For MarcsMusic, musicwnyo@gmail.com covers Electronic Beats, Non-English/World, Pop and Specialty; music@wnyo889.org is separately labelled MUSIC SUBMISSIONS ONLY. A human must select exactly one best-fit mailbox, confirm international eligibility, accepted release type, attachment-versus-download-link method, audio and size requirements, metadata, explicit-content, release-window and AI-origin rules, then send one individualized submission manually. Do not send the same release to multiple WNYO departments. Do not use the student-only, syndicated-programme, general-inquiry, page-comment, request-line, underwriting, donation or social routes as substitutes.
